units.source_text: “嘿，小孩子家瞎嚷什么……吾八你也别不吭声呀。”

en.t: Hey, what are you children making such a racket about... Gohachi, you say something too.
After saying that, Otaki walked out of the room.

units.source_text: 阿芳正在厨房里，阿泷一把揪住她的胸口，连推带搡地把她从走廊上直拽到房间里来。

en.t: Afang was in the kitchen, and Otaki grabbed her by the front of her clothes, shoving and pushing her as she dragged her straight from the corridor into the room.

units.source_text: 然后又把她拖到吾八跟前，啐了一声：“给你！”

en.t: Then she dragged her over in front of Gohachi, spat in disgust, and said, Here, take her!
